title: RunLocke: the Nuzlocke tracker I wanted
series: AI x Pokémon (same episode as 34-runlocke and 430-runlocke-micapm; this is a restyle, not a new episode)
hook: RunLocke: the Nuzlocke tracker I wanted
summary: I built the Nuzlocke tracker I always wanted.
body: I built the Nuzlocke tracker I always wanted.

Nuzlocke runs usually live in a notes app, a spreadsheet and a pile of screenshots.
RunLocke puts every encounter, death and boss fight in one place, for Nuzlocke and Kaizo runs.
Log your team, track deaths, plan the next gym and keep a Hall of Fame of every finished run.
Doing a run right now? Tell me the game and your starter in the comments.
